name: X3 agent delegation
applies_when: Orca is available: `orca worktree current --json` succeeds from the repo. If not, ignore this file and do the work directly.

verified.smoke_tests: read-only task 'list the topic files in docs/discoveries/README.md' returned the correct 11 names from both Codex (via orca agent launch) and OpenCode (via opencode run)

does: anything touching the unit, the USB stick or MCU safety rules
verifying worker output against the files before it reaches docs

builder.status: works (launch returned a terminal handle, prompt handed to terminal, task completed)
good_for: writing or refactoring tools and scripts (extract.py, repack.py, shims)
cross-compile setup for the ARM shim
tests and checks for existing tools

cheap.orca_launch_status: NOT working: `orca agent launch --agent opencode` returned agent_session_operation_unknown twice (also with --retry-launch) and no terminal appeared. Use `opencode run`, from a shell or `orca terminal create --worktree <sel> --command ...`.
cheap.note: `opencode run` goes through the background service and has no --timeout: bound the task in the brief. Do not pass --auto outside a disposable worktree.
good_for: grep and summarise decompile exports in fw/decomp
list call sites or callers of a function
cross-check docs against each other for drift
draft discovery notes from FINDINGS text
first-pass review of translations in tools/strings/tables_final.json

rules_for_every_worker: Work only in your own Orca worktree; never edit files in the main checkout.
Read-only everywhere else: /Volumes/X3DIAG, the head unit, and fw/ (read it from the main checkout by absolute path; git worktrees do not contain the gitignored fw/ dir).
Do not open or write the Ghidra project fw/gh (it locks). For new analysis import into a private project dir under your scratchpad.
No git push, no new remotes, no commits to main. Commit on your own branch only if asked.
Follow AGENTS.md: cite only what a tool showed, tag evidence levels, no personal data from captures, no raw NAND reads, never write ttyS1 or send MCU cmd 0x75.
Return facts with file and line or address evidence. The orchestrator re-checks every address and offset before it goes into docs.
brief_template: Task: <one sentence>. Repo: /Users/pradeesh/orca/projects/eanon-fw (read AGENTS.md first). Inputs: <paths; fw/ lives at /Users/pradeesh/orca/projects/eanon-fw/fw, read-only>. Output: <exact deliverable and where to write it, inside your worktree>. Limits: <time/size bounds>. Do not: push, touch the unit or USB stick, write outside your worktree. Report: what you did, evidence (file:line / address) for every claim, and anything you could not verify.
